_doc: Room recipes, by room key (dune-run --rooms). parts: people and objects painted into the room, redone in close-up (box in low-res pixels). A part may name a character (recipes/cast.json), set its own strength, cond, soften, zoom, seed, margin (crop height / box height, default 1.4) darken (areas darkened in the close-up's guide only, e.g. a grey rifle beside a grey leg) and close (fills warm gaps such as faces and hands inside the selected outline, in pixels). same_as copies another part's recipe; copy_of reuses another part's HD result for the same sprite drawn again (same box size; flip for a mirrored copy).

defaults.negative: out of focus, depth of field, bokeh, blurry, soft focus, haze, cartoon, anime, painting, illustration, drawing, pixel art, cgi, 3d render, deformed, text, watermark, frame, noise
